title: Hexus Salts Blueberry Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Blueberry Raspberry by Hexus brings together two popular berry flavours in a smooth, fruity mix. The Blueberry adds a mellow, juicy sweetness, while the Raspberry sharpens the blend with a gentle tang. The result is a clean, well-rounded vape that's rich in flavour ideal for fans of classic fruit profiles. Formulated with nicotine salts, this e-liquid delivers fast-acting nicotine satisfaction and a smooth, comfortable throat hit. It's blended at a 50VG/50PG ratio, making it a great match for low-powered pod kits and vape pens. Explore the full Hexus Nic Salt range for fruity, fizzy and cooling flavours in 10mg and 20mg strengths made for MTL devices.
